ReportType.description:
Report type, sent as its DISPLAY NAME (not a machine slug).

Seven types produce data. `Defects Summary` and `Defects Detailed Report` are
accepted on create/update but have no data branch on the server, so such a report
always reads back with `report_data: null` — never offer them as a way to report
on defects (use `Test Run Summary`, whose sections include `issues_by_priority` /
`issues_by_status`).

Pick by what the user asked about:
  - test cases created / updated / deleted, churn, top creators → `Test Case Activity`
  - run execution + pass rates                                 → `Test Run Summary`
  - per-case results within runs                               → `Test Run Detailed Report`
  - plan-level rollup                                          → `Test Plan Summary`
  - requirement/issue coverage                                 → `Requirement Traceability Report`
  - exploratory sessions                                       → `Exploratory Session Summary`
  - per-user workload                                          → `User Workload Report`
